steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「邊緣與游離皮瓣」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'margins and free-flap reconstruction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依口腔癌切除與重建的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Oral cancer resection and reconstruction.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 口腔癌切除與重建的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Oral cancer resection and reconstruction.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：檳榔相關病變
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「檳榔相關病變」在口腔癌切除與重建中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Betel-related lesions' within Oral cancer resection and reconstruction, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「檳榔相關病變」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Betel-related lesions': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「檳榔相關病變」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Betel-related lesions'.
steps.failure: 若「檳榔相關病變」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Betel-related lesions' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「檳榔相關病變」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Betel-related lesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「檳榔相關病變」是口腔癌切除與重建的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Betel-related lesions' is a core component of Oral cancer resection and reconstruction; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：檳榔相關病變」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Betel-related lesions'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「檳榔相關病變」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Betel-related lesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：邊緣與游離皮瓣
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: margins and free-flap reconstruction
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「邊緣與游離皮瓣」在口腔癌切除與重建中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'margins and free-flap reconstruction' within Oral cancer resection and reconstruction, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「邊緣與游離皮瓣」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'margins and free-flap reconstruction': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「邊緣與游離皮瓣」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'margins and free-flap reconstruction'.
steps.failure: 若「邊緣與游離皮瓣」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'margins and free-flap reconstruction' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「邊緣與游離皮瓣」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'margins and free-flap reconstruction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「邊緣與游離皮瓣」是口腔癌切除與重建的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'margins and free-flap reconstruction' is a core component of Oral cancer resection and reconstruction; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：邊緣與游離皮瓣」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: margins and free-flap reconstruction'?
options: 已正確完成「邊緣與游離皮瓣」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'margins and free-flap reconstruction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「檳榔相關病變」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Betel-related lesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「檳榔相關病變」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Betel-related lesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出口腔癌切除與重建的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Oral cancer resection and reconstruction and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「檳榔相關病變」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Betel-related lesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出下頜骨骨折固定的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Mandibular fracture fixation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：咬合復位、鈦板與 Champy 原則。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Occlusal reduction, plates and Champy principles.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「咬合復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Occlusal reduction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依下頜骨骨折固定的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Mandibular fracture fixation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 下頜骨骨折固定的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Mandibular fracture fixation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：咬合復位
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「咬合復位」在下頜骨骨折固定中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Occlusal reduction' within Mandibular fracture fixation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「咬合復位」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Occlusal reduction': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「咬合復位」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Occlusal reduction'.
steps.failure: 若「咬合復位」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Occlusal reduction' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「咬合復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Occlusal reduction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「咬合復位」是下頜骨骨折固定的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Occlusal reduction' is a core component of Mandibular fracture fixation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：咬合復位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Occlusal reduction'?
options: 已正確完成「咬合復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'Occlusal reduction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：鈦板與 Champy 原則
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: plates and Champy principles
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「鈦板與 Champy 原則」在下頜骨骨折固定中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'plates and Champy principles' within Mandibular fracture fixation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「鈦板與 Champy 原則」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'plates and Champy principles': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「鈦板與 Champy 原則」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'plates and Champy principles'.
steps.failure: 若「鈦板與 Champy 原則」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'plates and Champy principles' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「鈦板與 Champy 原則」是下頜骨骨折固定的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'plates and Champy principles' is a core component of Mandibular fracture fixation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：鈦板與 Champy 原則」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: plates and Champy principles'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「咬合復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'Occlusal reduction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 已正確完成「咬合復位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「鈦板與 Champy 原則」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: 'Occlusal reduction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'plates and Champy principles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出下頜骨骨折固定的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Mandibular fracture fixation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.title: 機制與病理生理
steps.objective: 掌握兒童牙科與氟化物的背景與基本機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of Paediatric dentistry and fluoride.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：齲齒預防、溝隙封填與行為管理。
steps.instructionEn: Read and organise: Caries prevention, sealants and behaviour management.
steps.observation: 以流程圖畫出因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: 齲齒預防、溝隙封填與行為管理。
knowledge.textEn: Caries prevention, sealants and behaviour management.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Mechanism and pathophysiology'?
options: 病例推理完整。
已正確完成「溝隙封填與行為管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
'sealants and behaviour management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵名詞與分類
steps.objective: 建立本題的名詞表與分類架構。
steps.objectiveEn: Build the glossary and classification for this topic.
steps.instruction: 列出 8–12 個關鍵名詞，各以一句話定義，並以表格呈現分類。
steps.instructionEn: List 8–12 key terms with one-sentence definitions and tabulate the classification.
steps.observation: 完成名詞表。
steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.
steps.failure: 名詞混用會導致後續判斷錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mixing terms leads to later misjudgement.
steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

knowledge.title: 分類的目的
knowledge.text: 分類應服務於治療決策或預後。
knowledge.textEn: Classification should serve treatment decisions or prognosis.

quiz.question: 「關鍵名詞與分類」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key terms and classification'?
options: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
已正確完成「齲齒預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
optionsEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.
'Caries prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：齲齒預防
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「齲齒預防」在兒童牙科與氟化物中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Caries prevention' within Paediatric dentistry and fluoride, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「齲齒預防」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'Caries prevention': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「齲齒預防」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'Caries prevention'.
steps.failure: 若「齲齒預防」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Caries prevention' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「齲齒預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Caries prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「齲齒預防」是兒童牙科與氟化物的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Caries prevention' is a core component of Paediatric dentistry and fluoride; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：齲齒預防」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Caries prevention'?
options: 已正確完成「齲齒預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「溝隙封填與行為管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
optionsEn: 'Caries prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'sealants and behaviour management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：溝隙封填與行為管理
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: sealants and behaviour management
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「溝隙封填與行為管理」在兒童牙科與氟化物中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'sealants and behaviour management' within Paediatric dentistry and fluoride, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「溝隙封填與行為管理」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'sealants and behaviour management': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「溝隙封填與行為管理」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'sealants and behaviour management'.
steps.failure: 若「溝隙封填與行為管理」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'sealants and behaviour management' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「溝隙封填與行為管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'sealants and behaviour management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「溝隙封填與行為管理」是兒童牙科與氟化物的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'sealants and behaviour management' is a core component of Paediatric dentistry and fluoride; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：溝隙封填與行為管理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: sealants and behaviour management'?
options: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
已正確完成「溝隙封填與行為管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
已正確完成「齲齒預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.
'sealants and behaviour management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
'Caries prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 治療與實證

steps.title: 治療與實證
steps.objective: 整合治療原則、證據等級與現代意義。
steps.objectiveEn: Integrate treatment principles, evidence levels and modern relevance.
steps.instruction: 列出一線與二線做法、支持證據（試驗／指引／經典條文）與限制。
steps.instructionEn: List first- and second-line approaches, supporting evidence (trials/guidelines/classical passages) and limitations.
steps.observation: 寫一段 150 字總結。
steps.observationEn: Write a 150-word summary.
steps.failure: 證據等級與推薦強度不可混淆。
steps.failureEn: Evidence level and recommendation strength are not the same thing.
steps.check: 總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
steps.checkEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.

knowledge.title: 證據金字塔
knowledge.text: 系統性回顧與 RCT 位於頂端，專家意見在底層。
knowledge.textEn: Systematic reviews and RCTs sit at the top; expert opinion at the bottom.

quiz.question: 「治療與實證」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Treatment and evidence'?
options: 病例推理完整。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 病例應用與自我測驗
steps.objective: 以一個病例或情境應用本題。
steps.objectiveEn: Apply the topic to a case or scenario.
steps.instruction: 描述情境→列出鑑別→選擇處置→預測結果→比較實際。
steps.instructionEn: Describe the scenario → list differentials → choose management → predict outcome → compare with reality.
steps.observation: 完成病例紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Complete the case record.
steps.failure: 跳過鑑別診斷直接下結論是危險的捷徑。
steps.failureEn: Skipping the differential is a dangerous shortcut.
steps.check: 病例推理完整。
steps.checkEn: Case reasoning complete.

knowledge.title: 反思
knowledge.text: 每個病例都應回答：我學到什麼、下次會怎麼做。
knowledge.textEn: Every case should answer: what did I learn, what will I do differently.

quiz.question: 「病例應用與自我測驗」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Case application and self-test'?
options: 已正確完成「齲齒預防」並以文字或數據留下證據。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: 'Caries prevention' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Case reasoning complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出顳顎關節鏡的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of TMJ arthroscopy.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：關節沖洗、沾黏鬆解。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Lavage and lysis of adhesions.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: 'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依顳顎關節鏡的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for TMJ arthroscopy.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 顳顎關節鏡的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of TMJ arthroscopy.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：關節沖洗
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「關節沖洗」在顳顎關節鏡中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Lavage' within TMJ arthroscopy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「關節沖洗」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Lavage': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「關節沖洗」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Lavage'.
steps.failure: 若「關節沖洗」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Lavage' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「關節沖洗」是顳顎關節鏡的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Lavage' is a core component of TMJ arthroscopy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：關節沖洗」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Lavage'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：沾黏鬆解
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「沾黏鬆解」在顳顎關節鏡中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'lysis of adhesions' within TMJ arthroscopy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「沾黏鬆解」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'lysis of adhesions': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「沾黏鬆解」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'lysis of adhesions'.
steps.failure: 若「沾黏鬆解」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'lysis of adhesions' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「沾黏鬆解」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'lysis of adhesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「沾黏鬆解」是顳顎關節鏡的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'lysis of adhesions' is a core component of TMJ arthroscopy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：沾黏鬆解」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: lysis of adhesions'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「沾黏鬆解」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'lysis of adhesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「關節沖洗」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Lavage' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「沾黏鬆解」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'lysis of adhesions' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出顳顎關節鏡的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of TMJ arthroscopy and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明數位牙科與 CAD/CAM的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Digital dentistry and CAD/CAM applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：口內掃描、設計與切削／3D 列印。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Intra-oral scanning, design and milling/3D printing.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 口內掃描、設計與切削／3D 列印。
knowledge.textEn: Intra-oral scanning, design and milling/3D printing.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「設計與切削／3D 列印」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「口內掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'design and milling/3D printing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Intra-oral scanning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 已正確完成「口內掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: 'Intra-oral scanning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 數位牙科與 CAD/CAM的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Digital dentistry and CAD/CAM.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：口內掃描
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「口內掃描」在數位牙科與 CAD/CAM中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Intra-oral scanning' within Digital dentistry and CAD/CAM, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「口內掃描」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Intra-oral scanning': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「口內掃描」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Intra-oral scanning'.
steps.failure: 若「口內掃描」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Intra-oral scanning' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「口內掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Intra-oral scanning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「口內掃描」是數位牙科與 CAD/CAM的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Intra-oral scanning' is a core component of Digital dentistry and CAD/CAM; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：口內掃描」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Intra-oral scanning'?
options: 已正確完成「口內掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Intra-oral scanning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.observation: 記錄「設計與切削／3D 列印」的設定、讀值或所見。

steps.failure: 若「設計與切削／3D 列印」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'design and milling/3D printing' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「設計與切削／3D 列印」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'design and milling/3D printing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「設計與切削／3D 列印」是數位牙科與 CAD/CAM的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'design and milling/3D printing' is a core component of Digital dentistry and CAD/CAM; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「口內掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Intra-oral scanning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
